reasons.action: The request only repositions the car in a new setting; it does not ask for a new behavior or performance, so the clip’s observed action remains reference-governed.
reasons.medium: The medium decision preserves the live-action/cinematic rendering; no requested style or medium change overrides it.
reasons.wardrobe: No change to the car’s carbon-fibre body or any accessory is requested, so the reference appearance governs.
reasons.lighting: “At night” and “wet dock road” are time and place cues, not an explicit instruction about a light source, direction or visible quality; reference lighting governs.
reasons.framing: No camera composition, shot scale, viewpoint or camera movement is specified; placement on a road is not framing, so reference framing governs.
reasons.palette: No explicit color grade or tonal-contrast treatment is requested; the night/wet setting alone does not regrade the scene, so reference palette governs.
